purpose: Add the Valsecchi-Jopek-Froeschle D_N geocentric-observable criterion to the exact frozen SonotaCo sparse-episode benchmark without changing the OrbitTrace detector or any previous comparator result.

references.title: Meteoroid stream identification: a new approach — I. Theory
Meteoroid stream identification: a new approach — II. Application to 865 photographic meteor orbits

independent_corpus: SonotaCo 2023 one-shot only after source and rules are frozen

shared_benchmark.calibration: identical Mondrian calibration-negative episodes and conservative rank p-values

published_criterion.angular_branch: minimum of the direct and paired 180-degree twin-node differences

episode_scores.classification: published D_N distance and single-neighbour linkage evaluated at M=6 for direct parity with the existing six-member classical comparator
episode_scores.score: negative first single-link distance at which a component reaches six events

episode_scores.classification: predeclared sparse benchmark transfer; not a separately published four-member pipeline
episode_scores.score: negative first single-link distance at which a component reaches four events

threshold_boundary: The original application estimated sample- and membership-dependent chance thresholds. This benchmark does not claim to reproduce that simulation; it applies the published distance and linkage and uses the benchmark's identical empirical negative calibration.
prohibitions: Do not change the frozen OrbitTrace detector, episode generator, seeds, folds, calibration panels, or gates.
Do not choose weights, target membership, or transformations after viewing results.
Do not call the M=4 transfer a published four-member D_N pipeline.
Do not claim reproduction of the original chance-threshold simulations.
Do not access or score SonotaCo 2023 before the 2025 source and result are frozen.
Do not inspect OrbitTrace coordinates, members, scores, or recovery outcomes during development.
